title: How I Make $68K/Month Investing in Stocks (Just Copy Me)
summary: Long-term investing primer: inflation erodes cash, compound growth over decades, index funds beat most managers, pay off debt first; includes a brokerage sponsor segment.

assertions.quote: Every year, my father's money was losing value due to inflation.
If you were able to invest $250 per month, at an 8% annual return, in 42 years, you'd be a millionaire

verdicts.note: Standard compound-growth arithmetic at historical equity returns.

assertions.quote: I allocate most of my money to index funds. This is definitely the best strategy for most people.
the average actively managed fund return 2% less per year than the market in general
no one has ever lost any money if they've bought and held an S&P 500 index fund for more than 20 years

verdicts.note: True for every rolling twenty-year period in nominal terms since 1926, though real returns were near zero in a few.

assertions.quote: There's no point trying to make 10% in the stock market, if you are paying 15% to a credit card company.
the real secret ingredient to this millionaire formula is time
